author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: The loopback-host allowlist is duplicated in the composable's parent-host check.
findings.consequence: The policies could drift and make local parent and target HTTP authorization inconsistent.
findings.evidence: The module and composable independently declare the identical localhost, IPv4 loopback, and IPv6 loopback set.
findings.recommendation: Reuse one isLoopbackHostname policy while retaining explicit allowLocalHttp capability.
verification: Compared both hostname policies and their tests.
Generated and read the exact current origin packet, options, and loopback policy.
Inspected both URL builders, runtime config caller, parent capability check, fallback caller, complete origin tests, lifecycle local/production behavior, stage wiring, and configuration tests.
Ran read-only URL probes for credentials, IPv6 loopback, and noncanonical forms.
